checks.name: tunnel_surface

summary.triangle_quality_note: Q = 4 sqrt(3) area / sum(edge length squared). 1 is equilateral; 0 is degenerate. Shape quality is not surface accuracy.
summary.topology_note: Components are triangles joined through shared edges. Open boundary edges can be intentional portals or measurement limits. These checks do not test self-intersections or certify watertightness or measurement coverage.
summary.fit_note: Area-weighted surface samples; normalized squared Chamfer = half the sum of directional mean squared nearest-neighbour distances. Approximate, not exact point-to-triangle deviation. summary.smoothing: None; median radius per occupied cell
summary.support_coverage_note: Fraction of measured grid cells used by at least one triangle. This measures measured-support retention; it does not certify that an unmeasured region is complete.
summary.warning: One approximately straight branch; grid vertices are fitted positions. Small gaps are interpolated in one pass only up to the stated local distance. Large gaps and ends stay open. summary.median_approximation: Exact support counts from every finite retained measurement; median of up to 17 reproducibly sampled measured radii per cell. Cells within that capacity use the exact median. Reservoir priorities use original point IDs, independent of input chunk boundaries. Larger cells use an approximate median.
summary.point_spacing_note: Estimated distance between spatially distributed measured fit-reference points, not full-source point spacing.

targeted_resolution_check.purpose: One explicitly requested coarser full-area setting to distinguish requested detail from measurement support; not a version performance comparison or a proposed default.

numerical_method.distance: Unsigned nearest triangle-interior distance, including triangle edges/vertices; not sampled-vertex nearest neighbour.
numerical_method.computation_dtype: float32 after subtracting float64 local origin

review_reasons: 631 separate edge-connected surfaces. Inspect whether these are intentional separate areas or missing connections; all components were retained.
Many disconnected triangle pieces remain. Do not treat this result as a continuous tunnel lining.
Only 91.6% of measured lining cells support a triangle. Inspect sparse areas, cell size and the maximum edge before treating this as a continuous lining.
app_mesh_summary.triangle_quality_note: Q = 4 sqrt(3) area / sum(edge length squared). 1 is equilateral; 0 is degenerate. Shape quality is not surface accuracy.
app_mesh_summary.topology_note: Components are triangles joined through shared edges. Open boundary edges can be intentional portals or measurement limits. These checks do not test self-intersections or certify watertightness or measurement coverage.
app_mesh_summary.fit_note: Area-weighted surface samples; normalized squared Chamfer = half the sum of directional mean squared nearest-neighbour distances. Approximate, not exact point-to-triangle deviation. Reference points are bounded spatial representatives of retained measurements; this is not full-density survey deviation.
app_mesh_summary.smoothing: None; median radius per occupied cell
app_mesh_summary.support_coverage_note: Fraction of measured grid cells used by at least one triangle. This measures measured-support retention; it does not certify that an unmeasured region is complete.
app_mesh_summary.warning: One approximately straight branch; grid vertices are fitted positions. Small gaps are interpolated in one pass only up to the stated local distance. Large gaps and ends stay open. For curved tunnels use Alignment-grid; separate junctions and clean equipment first. Radial medians do not identify services when services dominate a cell.
app_mesh_summary.median_approximation: Exact support counts from every finite retained measurement; median of up to 17 reproducibly sampled measured radii per cell. Cells within that capacity use the exact median. Reservoir priorities use original point IDs, independent of input chunk boundaries. Larger cells use an approximate median.
app_mesh_summary.point_spacing_note: Estimated distance between spatially distributed measured fit-reference points, not full-source point spacing.

limitations: Native Windows/WebView2 execution is unavailable on this Linux build host. Installer bytes and the matching-version Linux geometry engines are checked separately.
The full 550-million-point user project is unavailable; actual field verification uses the available 10,125,420-point scan with an excluded independent holdout.
The complete raw field scan still has fragmented sparse tails. More measured area and improved full-tunnel point-to-surface fit do not establish a fully connected or semantically classified lining.
The central Auto case retains every holdout point in its metrics, including an unlabelled small interior cluster that the new surface no longer closely follows.
Open portals are intentional. Connected edge topology does not certify self-intersection freedom, survey accuracy or watertight volume.
Per-cell support counts are exact; heavily populated cells use a bounded approximate median. Generic methods use measured spatial representatives.
Research-informed tests and triangle quality metrics are not full IPCMS or Point2Mesh reconstruction implementations.
Historical releases remain preserved and are not counted as current reruns.
